provenance.source_scope_note: Codex `rust-v0.162.1` resolves to `092d3acd`, while observed development main was `cc7ba336`; TypeScript and Python SDK published metadata named 0.162.1. Claude Code `v2.1.296` and Agent SDK `v0.3.296` are public releases; the previously assessed Desktop route used Code RC 2.1.284 and other distinct wrapper inputs. The Claude ACP adapter pinned SDK 0.3.293. T3 outside-caller claims came from main `5ce5a8f` and cannot be assigned to v0.0.45. OpenClaw claims use stable v2026.10.1, not the newer observed main. AI Functions behavior uses commit `145efc8` under an `openai-codex>=0.147.0` dependency, not an inferred 0.162.1 runtime. Public source revisions and mutable documentation access dates identify evidence, not installed executors or live account access.
